Mongolia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Bejing, China.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Vienna):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Mongolia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
